valid.code: namespace X { interface FooInterface { readonly x: number; } }
valid.name: namespace contract ending with Interface

valid.code: interface PureData { value: string; count: number; }
valid.name: pure-data interface is owned by interface-must-be-contract
empty interface is owned by interface-must-be-contract

invalid.code: namespace X { interface Foo { readonly x: number; } }
invalid.name: namespace contract missing Interface suffix

invalid.code: interface Branded { readonly __brand: unique symbol; value: string; }
invalid.name: brand contract missing Interface suffix

invalid.code: interface Handler { run(): void; config: { retries: number }; }
invalid.name: contract with inline pure data missing Interface suffix
